dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I won't hurt you. What are you chasing?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: My shadow. Everyone says I won't be able to catch it, including my big brother.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: My big brother is the smartest person I know. He can do anything I ask him to! But even he couldn't catch my shadow...

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: I'm sure there must be a way, though, and once I've caught it, it'll prove that I'm as smart as him!

response.speaker: Little You
response.text: Thanks for the offer, but I can do it.

response.speaker: Little You
response.text: I'm the one my whole family worries about, and I've had enough of it.

response.speaker: Little You
response.text: If I prove I'm as smart as my big brother then Granddad will stop worrying about me, and so will Mommy and Daddy, who work far away from home.

choices.text: Why don't you play with your big brother?

response.speaker: Little You
response.text: I really want to, but... It seems like he doesn't want to, he's really busy and— and I think he might be trying to avoid me.

response.speaker: Little You
response.text: Granddad says I should be a good girl. I don't want to annoy my big brother.
